title: Miss Mackenzie
summary: "Miss Mackenzie" by Anthony Trollope is a novel written in 1864 and published in 1865. After years spent nursing dying relatives, thirty-five-year-old Margaret Mackenzie suddenly inherits a fortune and enters society for the first time. Inexperienced and uncertain, she attracts three suitors with varying motives in the spa town of Littlebath.
